headline: Markets closed for weekend; FPI flows, crude oil trends, and global cues to drive direction this week

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Stock markets are closed today, Sunday, 22 November 2026, due to the weekend.
Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) made a record monthly bet of Rs 1.22 lakh crore, offsetting nearly half of 2026 selloffs.
Crude oil futures are bracing for an upcoming OPEC+ output decision amidst supply glut concerns.
India and the EU are likely to sign a key trade pact on December 16.
whatHappening: Analysts expect market sentiment this week to be driven by FPI flows, crude oil movements, and global trends.
The InvIT IPO rush is gaining momentum with 4-5 private trusts likely to go public by March 2027.
CCPA slapped a Rs 10-lakh fine on a firm for listing an 'anti-drone gun' on e-commerce platform IndiaMART.
Air quality concerns rise as Lahore tops world pollution rankings with three Indian cities in the top 10.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November 2026. In last session's aftermath, strong FPI inflows of Rs 1.22 lakh crore provided major market support. Analysts point to upcoming OPEC+ crude oil decisions, FPI movement, and global trends as key factors dictating market direction this week.
